walkthrough:
Express $BD$ using the right-angled triangle $DBC$ (hypotenuse $BC = 20$ cm):
$$\sin\theta = \frac{BD}{20} \implies BD = 20\sin\theta$$

Express $BD$ using the right-angled triangle $ABD$ (where $\angle ABD = 90^\circ - (90^\circ - \theta) = \theta$ and $AD = 9$ cm):
$$\tan\theta = \frac{AD}{BD} = \frac{9}{BD} \implies BD = \frac{9}{\tan\theta} = \frac{9\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}$$

Equate both expressions for $BD$ and simplify:
$$20\sin\theta = \frac{9\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} \implies 20\sin^2\theta = 9\cos\theta$$

Substitute $\sin^2\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta$ into the equation from part (i):
$$20(1 - \cos^2\theta) = 9\cos\theta \implies 20\cos^2\theta + 9\cos\theta - 20 = 0$$
